subtasks.objective: Prevent arbitrary customer order-history disclosure from fav_items and customer_favourite_item by enforcing authorization on the requested Customer before aggregating POS Invoice item history.
subtasks.acceptance: fav_items(customer) and customer_favourite_item(customer_name) reject requests for customers the current user cannot read or that are outside the user's permitted restaurant/branch context, and still return the existing favorite-item aggregate for authorized customers. Add focused backend tests or equivalent Frappe test coverage showing unauthorized customer requests are denied and authorized requests preserve the expected aggregation.
